title: Route plan written by orchestrate-story
description: The orchestrator's decision for one story: which design agents and which reviewers take part, and why. factory/board.py validates it and applies the policy floor (mandatory reviewers) before the runner executes it.

risk_level.description: RITMO risk level: 1 = security or data integrity, 2 = value, 3 = cosmetic/low.

touches_contract.description: True if the story changes contracts/, docs/data-contract.md, a database schema or a message the backend or frontend reads.
